title: Biofidelic Goat Model Developed for Traumatic Optic Neuropathy
summary: Researchers combined finite element analysis and transnasal endoscopy to create a reproducible goat model of traumatic optic neuropathy.

title: Dutch Startup Developing Motorcycle-Stance Hypercar
summary: An automotive startup in the Netherlands is designing an 800-hp hypercar where the driver sits leaned forward like on a motorcycle.

title: ULA Vulcan Centaur Fails Early in Flight
summary: United Launch Alliance reported that its Vulcan Centaur rocket failed during launch due to an issue with its first-stage booster.

title: COMAC's CE-25A Electric Airliner Carries Crew
summary: COMAC's fully electric CE-25A aircraft completed its first crewed flight with two pilots and a flight test engineer on board.

title: Researchers Propose Defect-Aware Chiplet Matching
summary: ASU and Ampere Computing researchers published a method for defect- and topology-aware chiplet matching to optimize heterogeneous integration yield.

title: KAIST Proposes Backside Clock Mesh Architecture
summary: KAIST researchers published a clock distribution network design placing the clock mesh on backside metal layers to reduce skew and power.

title: TAIYO YUDEN Introduces New LTCC Solutions
summary: TAIYO YUDEN released advanced LTCC solutions for UWB and Bluetooth Low Energy applications to aid miniaturization and RF performance.

title: Deloitte Launches Edisyl for Enterprise AI Context Packs
summary: Deloitte has launched Knowledge Packs to combine curated domain knowledge with internal company data across existing AI tools.

title: London Energy Recovery Facility Faces £451M Cost Increase
summary: The North London Waste Authority proposes increasing the Edmonton Energy Recovery Facility contract price following disputes with Acciona Industrial.

title: Honeywell and Keppel Partner for Low-Carbon Fuels
summary: Honeywell and Keppel are collaborating to evaluate sustainable aviation fuels, renewable diesel, and methanol production pathways in the Asia-Pacific region.

title: Galafoot Bridge Requires Repairs After Poor Concrete Discovery
summary: Refurbishment work on the Galafoot Bridge is extended after its concrete deck slab was found to be in worse condition than anticipated.

title: Cosmo Bee to Flight-Test Hall Thruster in 2027
summary: South Korean startup Cosmo Bee plans to test its 10 mN-class Honeybee Hall thruster in orbit with D-Orbit in 2027.

title: One-Atom-Thick Material Reveals Strange Quantum State
summary: Osaka University researchers discovered a quantum state with heavy-behaving electrons at the boundary between an ultrathin material and copper.

title: Self-Supervised Virtual Metrology Framework for CMP MRR
summary: Researchers proposed a self-supervised attention-based framework called GREP to predict chemical mechanical planarization removal rates from sensor signals.

title: Saloon Desk Turns Sofas Into Workstations
summary: A German inventor created a desk that straddles sofas and features independently adjustable desktops that swing open like saloon doors.

title: Michigan Regulators Set Dam Sales Deadline
summary: Michigan regulators set a December deadline for a decision regarding Consumers Energy's proposed sale of thirteen hydroelectric dams.

title: SpaceX to Make Starship Even Bigger with V4 Model
summary: Elon Musk announced that SpaceX's Starship rocket will be expanded further in its next-generation V4 iteration.

title: Voyager 1 Nears Distance of One Light-Day from Earth
summary: The interstellar probe Voyager 1 is approaching a distance of one light-day from Earth in deep space.

title: Hyperlyve Framework Certifies Deep ReLU Stability
summary: Researchers introduced Hyperlyve, a parallelized framework that proves the asymptotic stability of nonlinear systems with neural network controllers.

title: Partitioned MiLAC Architecture for MU-MIMO Precoding
summary: A partitioned Microwave Linear Analog Computer architecture was proposed for user-specific MU-MIMO precoding using independently configured analog subnetworks.

title: Lazy-MOSAIC Accelerates Manipulation Planning
summary: Researchers introduced Lazy-MOSAIC, a planning framework that uses a learned world model to accelerate skill-centric robot manipulation planning.

title: Decentralized Protocol Enables Safe Agent Disconnection
summary: A decentralized event-triggered topology-switching protocol allows multi-agent systems to disconnect safely from communication networks while reducing complexity.

title: Quantum Memory Advantage for Late-Graph Smoothness
summary: Researchers demonstrated an exponential quantum memory advantage over classical receivers for spectral estimation and late-graph smoothness testing.

title: Beamformer Design Enhances ISAC Location Privacy
summary: A beamformer design framework was developed to balance rate, sensing, and transmitter location privacy trade-offs in integrated sensing and communication systems.

title: Distributed Adaptive Identification of Nonlinear Systems without Input Sharing
summary: This paper studies continuous-time distributed adaptive identification for unknown nonlinear systems over directed networks without requiring source or neighbor inputs to be shared.

title: RESILAGENT: Cyber-Physical Resilience Architecture for Energy Systems
summary: RESILAGENT is a three-pillar architecture designed to handle hybrid threats, cyber intrusions, and climate-driven stress in electrical power and energy systems.

title: Warm Starting Neural Dynamics Models From Few Jacobian Samples
summary: Researchers propose TDec-Init, an algorithm to warm-start neural dynamics models using transition Jacobians to improve efficiency in model-based reinforcement learning.

title: Robust Action Clusters and Cascades in Opinion Dynamics
summary: This study investigates opinion dynamics in networks where agents update private opinions using heterogeneous action thresholds, characterizing robust action clusters and cascades.

title: Quantum Optimization Algorithm for Pinching-Antenna Activation
summary: Researchers propose a training-free quantum approximate optimization algorithm with a linear-ramp schedule for antenna activation in pinching-antenna systems.

title: Spain Renewable Sector Loses €140M Due to Grid Constraints
summary: Spain's renewable energy industry lost an estimated €140M in revenue to grid curtailment following recent grid constraints.
